question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Fervor
solution: The correct answer is "**Apathy**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of the word. • **Fervor**: intense and passionate feeling. • Let's look at the meaning of the given words. • **Seriousness: **the quality or state of being serious. • **Zeal: **great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause or an objective. • **Intensity: **the quality of being intense. • **Apathy: **lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern. • As per the meanings of the words, **"apathy" **is the antonym of **"fervor"**. • **Example**: *The management's apathy toward the workers' conditions led to a strike* Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • Let's look at the meaning of the word. • **Fervor**: तीव्र और भावुक भावना। • Let's look at the meaning of the given words. • **Seriousness: ** गंभीर होने की अवस्था या भाव। • **Zeal: ** किसी कारण या उद्देश्य की खोज में महान ऊर्जा या उत्साह। • **Intensity: ** तीव्र होने का गुण। • **Apathy: ** रुचि, उत्साह या चिंता की कमी। • As per the meanings of the words, **"apathy" **is the antonym of **"fervor".** 3d:T7a5, The correct answer is "**Fight with someone**"
